plugins.name: godw-design
plugins.description: godw design-pipeline plugin: four-stage pipeline — stage 1 raw requirement (human-in-loop freeze) -> stage 2 4A architecture + identity cards (2-a split: requirement leg + frozen 身份卡.md + reference INDEX; 2-b four docs + detail.json + model.c4 + use-case coverage matrix & per-role use-case views; 2-c doc gate) -> stage 3 PRD (3-a compose with EARS acceptance criteria wired to FR ids; 3-b adversarial review) -> stage 4 interactive prototype (4-a build + manifest.json; 4-b prototype gate with walk evidence + crawl dead-link/lazy-pattern scan + coverage check; 4-c wrap-up & auto-archive). godw-design-orchestrator auto-detects stage from directory state (state.md reconciled, directory wins); freeze gate stays human-in-loop. godw-design-gate dispatches dynamic user jurors from the frozen identity card (answer-sheet 能做/卡住/靠猜) with convergence registry + anchor card; prototype jurors really run walk.mjs with covers:[UC-xx] per exam, and the orchestrator runs walk.mjs coverage (every page visited, every role's UC set covered). v0.3.0 three-stage orchestrator + state.md + identity cards + answer sheets. v0.4.0 evidence-based acceptance: walk.mjs Playwright walker (doctor preflight, per-step screenshots, runId receipts; void re-dispatch without consuming rounds; main agent never ghostwrites). v0.5.0 four-stage + PRD + LikeC4: prd-compose (EARS AC machine-lintable, ≤30 per module, dual-channel ambiguity, fields referenced from detail.json only); gate prd mode + prototype-vs-PRD verdicts; model.c4 single architecture source via likec4 gen mermaid (never hand-written). v0.6.0 (gate coverage everywhere + mmdc removed, user-driven): check.mjs rebuilt into five phases (requirement/split/document/prd/proto, ~80 rules) — new requirement & split phase gates (skeleton/numbering/boundary/placeholders/GOAL dual-source; leg sections/card four-lines/six exam types/matrix alignment/INDEX row-count), document-phase use-case coverage trio (UC table with FR column, every FR >=1 use case, every role an exclusive mermaid use-case view whose nodes equal that role's UC set), state-diagram vs detail.states, NFR->quality-scenario per item, BR numbering, quantified metrics, unverifiable-word bans, sequence-diagram branch<=2, likec4 validate + gen drift detection, mermaid source-level validation; prd-phase AC-FR wiring (every AC cites >=1 FR/GR, every FR covered by >=1 AC, every module >=1 IF exception AC, numbering continuity, THE-form allowed), Input trace line, five global states, template-residue scan; proto-phase manifest three-way consistency + static lazy-pattern scan (see-xxx-doc placeholders / TODO / alert stubs / href="#" dead links) + crawl folding; --registry PASS-line computation. walk.mjs gains crawl (site-wide dead links + runtime lazy patterns + resource errors + manifest consistency) and coverage subcommands; exams gain covers field. hooks/ added: PreToolUse freeze fence (blocks writes to frozen 原始需求.md and snapshots) + Stop completion gate (stage-done claims require evidence, no-instance fast-pass). Mechanical FAILs auto-dispatch revision sub-agents in a loop (no juror rounds consumed, 10-loop cap, unlimited tokens). mmdc removed entirely (diagram validation = source-level checks + likec4 gen drift). Sibling plugins: godw-goal, godw-html, godw-toolkit. v0.7.0: regression exam pack (2 good fixtures + 6 planted mines, mechanical mines = release hard gate), fail buckets L1/L2 + convergence baseline (3+2 stop line), stop-gate check-freshness, unified scorecard, visual assertion judge (gate 3c, PRD UI AC over walk trace screenshots).

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: Godw Design：设计流水线域（需求→四架构文档→PRD→可交互原型）

description_i18n.zh-CN: godw设计流水线域插件。四阶段：阶段1 原始需求（人在环冻结）→ 阶段2 4A架构+身份卡（2-a 架构腿+身份卡+INDEX 建账；2-b 四文档+detail.json+model.c4+用例覆盖矩阵与每角色用例视图；2-c 门1）→ 阶段3 PRD（3-a 成文〔EARS 验收标准挂 FR〕；3-b 对抗审查）→ 阶段4 原型系统（4-a 可交互原型+manifest.json；4-b 合验门〔walk 证据+crawl 死链懒惰扫描+coverage 覆盖核对〕；4-c 收口归档）。godw-design-orchestrator 按目录实况自动识别阶段步骤（state.md 对账以目录为准），冻结门人在环不自动跨。godw-design-gate 用冻结身份卡派动态评委（答卷表 能做/卡住/靠猜），prototype 评委真跑走查器出证据、每题带 covers 用例声明，收卷后 coverage 机器核对每页每角色全覆盖；PASS 判定线由 check --registry 机器计算。godw-design-check 机械门五阶段 requirement/split/document/prd/proto（约 80 条规则）：阶段1 骨架/编号/边界/占位/双源；2-a 五节/四句/六类/矩阵对齐/INDEX 对账；document 用例覆盖三件套+状态图↔detail 一致+NFR→质量场景+BR 编号+likec4 gen 防漂移+mermaid 源码校验；prd AC 挂 FR 三查（每 AC 挂 FR、每 FR ≥1 AC、每模块 ≥1 异常 AC）+Input 溯源+全局状态五类；proto manifest 三向一致+懒惰模式静态扫描（参考文档占位/待实现/alert 桩/假链）。walk.mjs 增 crawl（全站死链+运行态懒惰+manifest 一致）与 coverage 子命令。hooks/ 双保险：冻结围栏+收工门（无实例秒放行）。机械 FAIL 自动派修订子 Agent 循环不耗评委轮次（Token 不设限）。mmdc 已整体移除。按名调用 godw-goal/godw-html/godw-toolkit。
